name: @agents-js/lifestone-projector
description: Lifestone agent-inbox projection: pure render/parse logic that mirrors the signed gateway inbox into an email-style lifestone mailbox (inbox/outbox/pending/failed/draft/saved/trash). Projection only — routing stays the gateway; lifestone is a view, never a second router. See lifestone hub/agent-inbox/PROJECTION-SPEC.md.
author: Jens Bodal
